## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test` / `node test/run.mjs`)
- [ ] Change is focused (one fix or feature)
- [ ] Existing comments preserved unless the code they describe changed
- [ ] Added or updated a test if encoding, chunking, or crypto logic changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
